macros.name: changepage
macros.doc: The \changepage command is for changing the general layout of a page.

macros.name: changetext

arg.snippet: changetext{${1:text height}}{${2:text width}}{${3:even-side margin}}{${4:odd-side margin}}{${5:column sep.}}

macros.doc: The given lengths are added to the corresponding current lengths and the remainder of the current page is typeset using the changed text block layout.

macros.name: checkoddpage
macros.doc: The \checkoddpage command can be used anywhere in the body of a document to determine if TeX is typesetting on an odd or even numbered page.

envs.name: adjustwidth
envs.doc: Within an adjustwidth environment the left and right margins can be adjusted.
